_comment: 构建期自动更新，手工改动会被覆盖（C 车道脚本从 JetBrains Marketplace API 重写本文件）。当前为 B 车道手工 stub，数据取自 https://plugins.jetbrains.com/api/plugins/33633/updates（2026-11-01）。summaryEn 为 summaryZh 的同义英文，非 Marketplace 原文。

updates.summaryZh: 装了 MyBatisCodeHelperPro 等同类插件时，Mapper 双向跳转图标不再和对方的跳转箭头叠在同一行
updates.summaryEn: Mapper two-way jump icons no longer overlap with arrows from similar plugins such as MyBatisCodeHelperPro

updates.summaryZh: 修复 IDEA 2026.1.x 启用 MCP Server 后内置服务对所有客户端不可用、必须卸载插件才恢复的问题
updates.summaryEn: Fixed IDEA 2026.1.x: after enabling the MCP Server the built-in service was unavailable to all clients until the plugin was uninstalled

updates.summaryZh: Mapper 接口方法与 XML 语句之间新增双向跳转，点行号旁的图标即可互跳
updates.summaryEn: New two-way navigation between mapper interface methods and XML statements via the gutter icon
